en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a wide, straight street lined with substantial late‑19th / early‑20th‑century townhouses or institutional buildings on both sides. The architecture shows steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, ornate gables and modest decoration, typical of Central European cities. Wooden and brick fences border leafy gardens, and a woman in a long dress walks along the left sidewalk while a cyclist rides in the distance. A tall utility pole stands in the center of the street, and handwritten white markings appear along the right edge of the image, suggesting cataloging or postcard titling.
